name: smwpatches-lemmy-wendy-dummy-penalty
title: Lemmy/Wendy Dummy Penalty
description:
This patch adds a penalty system for the Lemmy Koopa and/or Wendy O. Koopa boss fights. If you stomp one of their dummies, Lemmy/Wendy's hitpoint counter will be decremented, extending the boss fight as punishment for stomping the wrong sprite.

You can choose to have the penalty system in the Lemmy fight, Wendy fight, both, or neither (unpatch). You can also decide how many hitpoints are subtracted as penalty, including resetting the hitpoint counter completely.

Compatible with the Custom Boss HP patch.
